name: Fleet Battle
hook: Hide your fleet. Find theirs. A hit fires again.
how: Drag your five ships into place, then take turns firing at the enemy grid. A hit lets you fire again; sink every enemy ship first to win.
controls: Drag ships to move, tap to turn; click or tap a square to fire (arrows + Space work too)
uses: Your ships are sealed so only you can read them (the host answers every shot, so it can too).
The host's browser checks every shot and runs the turns; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot captain takes the empty seat, and a friend who joins takes over its fleet.
Matches won, shown after every match.
ideas: Make the grid 10 by 10 with a sixth ship
Add a radar that reveals a 3 by 3 area once per match
Make it space, with spaceships and asteroids
